technicalDecision.rule: only trusted backend may read/write authoritative business aggregate
technicalDecision.singleInvAtomicity: one RTDB transaction per authoritative INV document, rechecks ACL/epoch/transition/business/inbox-outbox and writes receipt with event
technicalDecision.why: Avoid independent role/proposal/outbox roots and browser writes which permit time-of-check/time-of-use races

authorityNotes.acl: Authoritative per-INV grants (not a read-through cache of lasala-roles-v1); Backoffice revocation mutates the same INV transaction
authorityNotes.fence: Per-INV epoch and phase in same transaction, reject stale commands
authorityNotes.grid: Canonical irrigation data, preserving legacy values during separately approved migration
authorityNotes.proposals: State pending/accepted/rejected and final irrigation mutation in same INV transaction
authorityNotes.problems: Durable original reporter, selected guard, affected INV/cells and state
authorityNotes.commands: Server-issued immutable authenticated intents, never browser-owned actor/role/destinations
authorityNotes.receipts: Durable command idempotency result, retries read same receipt
authorityNotes.events: Immutable business transition proofs referencing receipts, not a Push claim
authorityNotes.outbox: Pending dispatch instructions created atomically with transition; no push before commit

aggregate.scalabilityGuard: No unbounded root growth: measure aggregate size/ETag contention; design archive or partition boundaries before UAT without breaking atomicity

identity.authProvider: Firebase Auth ID token verified server-side; validate enabled/revoked status, mapped user and auth freshness
identity.legacyRoles: lasala-roles-v1 remains legacy source until approved cutover; never independently authoritative for v3 commits
identity.backoffice: Authenticated admin route; role/grant/epoch revocation must serialize through each affected INV transaction
identity.globalRevocation: Before acknowledging completion, fence every affected INV and verify each; not instantaneous across INV. Emergency global stop requires separately verified access-control design.
identity.principalTrust: User, role, inv, scope, recipient, phase and epoch derived server-side; no client flags trusted
identity.adminSdk: Privileged Admin SDK bypasses RTDB rules; enforce application authorization + minimal service credentials

operations.body: op + requested domain changes, no trusted actor/grants
operations.effect: authenticate/validate, create server-issued immutable command reference in protected store; no business transition
verify JWT and revalidate authoritative ACL/epoch/business state inside transaction; write data+receipt+event+pending outbox
return authorized caller's receipt or pending state; never raw grants
role-scoped read from server, no raw RTDB authority root
manager-approved per-INV transactional grant and fence updates with audit trail

responseModel.success: HTTP 200/201 with committed receipt, eventId and revision
responseModel.pending: HTTP 202 for intent awaiting commit, not saved business data

api.clientOutboxOwnership: local draft only until server receipt; never treat offline draft as committed

scope.multiInv: NO_GO until approved coordinator/locking/compensation design with no partially visible effects and recovery tests
scope.legacyProposalArray: NO_GO for write coexistence: proposal global array must be moved/normalized before cutover
scope.guardRotation: Server Europe/Madrid calculation from committed time; substitutions await Backoffice approval
scope.worker: Cloudflare/Tuta schedule independent; no duplicate weekly reminders

steps: G1 functional matrix and pending business decisions approved
G2 emulator security rules and backend authorization; demonstrate revoked old paths
Authorized backup+ETag manifest, offline device inventory and rollback rehearsal
Server-only shadow mode, no duplicate writes/push
Pilot one INV after old legacy writers are frozen and offline queues drained
Gradual migration with owner/approval, feature flags and audit
neverDo: allow both legacy and v3 authoritative writers
use synthetic serverVerified flags as security proof
backfill missing alerts or send historical Push

functionalApprovals.decision: Exact actor/role/grants by INV and regante sala
Proposal final-text and revert/duplicate rules, including multi-INV
Deleting irrigation and marking executed: audit/event behavior
Problem guard substitutions, reporter roles and notification rules
Offline cutover/lock window and exception handling

technicalGates.proof: Server-only RTDB root denies browser reads/writes at root and descendants (emulator)
JWT validity, revocation and user/role/INV ACL transactional mutation in a real trusted backend
Legacy direct writers revoked at precise paths, without breaking other modules
Single-INV CAS demonstrates role/freeze/proposal/receipt/outbox TOCTOU against official emulator
Global revocation and multi-INV partial failure policy approved and tested
Aggregate size, retention, backup, observability and replay/rollback measured
